text:
alex-partners: Hey team, we need a short, structured feed from hardware partners for our cost model: effective spot premium (pct), minimum commit months, onboarding/listing credit amount and whether refundable, fulfillment lag days, and any regional locks.
alex-partners: @vendor-bot please pull the latest from VegaCompute and HyperGrid and include tranche-release behavior if available.
vendor-bot: Uploaded CSV link. Fields added: sku,reserved_months,spot_premium_pct,onboarding_credit_usd,refundable_flag,fulfillment_days,region_code. Spot is 30-day median.
sara-finance: Is onboarding_credit_usd per-account or per-sku? That changes unit math.
vendor-bot: Note: credit_scope column added (account|sku). Sample: "sku=hg-a100,reserved_months=36,spot_premium_pct=15,onboarding_credit_usd=10000,refundable_flag=true,credit_scope=account,fulfillment_days=10,region_code=eu-west-1"
mike-eng: Also include eviction_prob_hourly and eviction_distribution buckets if possible. For reserved_months <6 our scheduler deprioritizes; tranche_release cadence helps simulate realized throughput.
vendor-bot: eviction_prob_hourly ranges provided (0.15%-1.2%). tranche_release string included e.g. "0:25,30:75" meaning 25% up front, 75% after 30 days.
olivia-ops: Add allow_burst boolean and suggested burst_markup_pct, plus payment_terms. If region_lock=true we route differently.
vendor-bot: Added allow_burst,burst_markup_pct,payment_terms,region_lock. Also appended blended_cost_usd_12q and minimum_monthly_commit_usd per partner.
sara-finance: Please ensure blended_cost_usd_12q states whether marketplace fees are included. If refundable_flag=true, include legal_ref_link.
alex-partners: Great. I'll send the exact CSV schema to partners and ask for the export by EOD so modeling can run tonight. :rocket:
mike-eng: Once data is in I'll run a quick sim to show cost vs latency tradeoffs with spot_premium +/-5ppt and tranche delays +/-14d.
vendor-bot: Export queued, will post link and checksum when ready. :white_check_mark:
